correctness.rationale: For the fixed dodecahedron vertices and t>0, sign of normal dot each vertex representative partitions the spherical normals by ten great circles. The actual exact checker in Z[φ] tests all 2^10 masks and all 90 oriented pair-circle intersection rays, proves no triple concurrence, and certifies precisely 92 nonempty full-dimensional chambers classified as 20 hexagonal, 60 octagonal, 12 decagonal sections. For decagons there are 60 polygon corners in precisely eight types (seven multiplicity-eight classes and one multiplicity-four class), all signed normal dot products equal 1, giving the explicit F_{a,b,c}(t²−1) angle formula via Girard spherical excess: [8Σ7F+4F_{1,1,−1}−36π]/4π. The coefficient formulas for arccos expansion in s=t²−1 have weighted order-1 and order-2 sums 0 and order-3 sum −125√2/6912, so p10 cubic coefficient is −125√2/(27648π); the singularity denominators are squared norms >0 for t>0. I inspected entire exact sign-arithmetic and SymPy symbolic checker; independent 100000-normal Monte Carlo at t=0.5,1,2 gave .12624/.12139/.11782 versus exact law .127411/.122602/.116891, consistent with bounded sampling error. Exhaustiveness is finite logical sign-enumeration; random normals alone prove no continuum formula.
